blends.name: Chocolate Stout - Hooligan Hobbies: Home Brewing
blends.desc:
A chocolate stout is a rich, dark beer that blends the roasted depth of a stout with smooth, velvety notes of cocoa or real chocolate. Its dessert-like flavor and creamy texture make it a decadent treat for fans of bold, sweet brews.
